excerpt: Project 8 Detects Individual Electrons by their Cyclotron Radiation. The prototype instrument demonstrating the new technique was built at the University of Washington. The demonstration involved detecting monoenergetic conversion electrons from 83mKr; the best reported resolution is 15 eV for a 30,477-eV emission.
publisher: U.S. Department of Energy, Office of Science, Office of Nuclear Physics
title: Project 8 Detects Individual Electrons by their Cyclotron Radiation
